commit.message:
fix(interpreter): word-split an unquoted expansion in command position

The interpreter expanded the command word with expandWord, which returns
one string with no field splitting and no globbing. A variable that holds
a command and its options was looked up as a single name, so
CC="echo cc -O2"; $CC -c x.c failed with "command not found" and exit 127
where bash prints "cc -O2 -c x.c". Fixes #457.

I now expand the command word with expandWordWithGlob, as the arguments
already are. The first field names the command and the remaining fields
become its leading arguments ahead of node.args. A quoted "$X" stays one
field, and the empty name path (x=''; $x echo ran) still shifts the first
argument into the name. The isLiteralAssignmentBuiltin check is unchanged.

The Oils spec case "Alias trailing newline" in alias.test.sh depends on
this split (e_ ${var} with var='echo foo') and now passes, so I removed
its SKIP line. The spec runner reports it as UNEXPECTED PASS otherwise.

Focused test before the fix

    pnpm --filter just-bash exec vitest run src/interpreter/command-word-splitting.test.ts
    × should split a variable holding a command and its options
    × should split a variable holding a builtin and its format
    × should split $* in command position and keep quoted $@ fields
    × should call a function named by the first field
    AssertionError: expected '' to be 'cc -O2 -c x.c\n'
    Tests  4 failed | 2 passed (6)

Focused test after the fix

    pnpm --filter just-bash exec vitest run src/interpreter/command-word-splitting.test.ts
    Tests  6 passed (6)

Wider checks after the fix

    pnpm --filter just-bash exec vitest run src/interpreter src/spec-tests/bash src/parser
    Test Files  77 passed (77)
    Tests  3689 passed | 1 skipped (3690)
    vitest run --config vitest.comparison.config.ts
    Test Files  61 passed (61)
    Tests  958 passed (958)
    pnpm lint
    exit 0, No banned patterns detected
    pnpm --filter just-bash typecheck
    exit 0
    pnpm build
    exit 0
    pnpm --filter just-bash test:unit
    Test Files  7 failed | 578 passed (585)
    Tests  9 failed | 15132 passed | 100 skipped (15241)

The 9 unit failures are python3 worker, root user and setuid probes.
The same 7 files fail with the same 9 tests on unfixed main in my
container (Tests  9 failed | 102 passed (111)).

End to end against dist/ through new Bash().exec, compared with
GNU bash 5.2.21

    CC="echo cc -O2"; $CC -c x.c              -> "cc -O2 -c x.c\n" 0
    ECHO='printf %s\n'; $ECHO hello world     -> "hello\nworld\n" 0
    set -- echo a b; $*                       -> "a b\n" 0
    X="echo a b"; $X                          -> "a b\n" 0
    f() { echo "f:$*"; }; CMD="f a b"; $CMD   -> "f:a b\n" 0
    X="echo a b"; "$X"                        -> stderr "bash: echo a b: command not found\n" 127

Real bash gives the same stdout and exit code for all six. Not run
pnpm knip, pnpm test:wasm and pnpm test:dist.
